notes: Scripted typewriter chat, no AI and no backend, ruled in Q13. Ten buyer questions in the order they are asked most. Every answer is 240 characters or fewer. No prices, no warranty terms, no competitor names, no personal names, no dash characters.
intro: Ask DSD. Ten questions, answered the way we answer them on the phone.

exchanges.question: How much is a dental chair?
exchanges.answer: It depends on the model and configuration, so we quote on request. Tell us the model and the room.

exchanges.question: Do you offer installment plans?
exchanges.answer: Yes, across the whole chair lineup. Terms move with the model, and the schedule comes with your quote.

exchanges.question: Do you deliver outside Metro Manila?
exchanges.answer: Yes, nationwide. Luzon gets our own install team. Visayas and Mindanao go by freight, installed on arrival.

exchanges.question: What happens if something goes wrong after the install?
exchanges.answer: We assess it on site and hold parts locally. If it will not clear quickly, a replacement unit goes in.

exchanges.question: When is the showroom open?
exchanges.answer: Every day, 9 AM to 8 PM, at 610 C. Raymundo Avenue, Maybunga, Pasig City. No appointment needed.

exchanges.question: Why Denjoy for endodontics?
exchanges.answer: We are the exclusive Denjoy partner here, so every unit is sealed and genuine, with spares and support in the country.

exchanges.question: Do you train my team?
exchanges.answer: Yes. Your staff train at handover on install day, and our Pasig Training Center runs longer simulator courses.

exchanges.question: Are spare parts available locally?
exchanges.answer: Yes. We hold parts here, from handpiece lines to control boards, so a same day repair is often possible.

exchanges.question: How long does an installation take?
exchanges.answer: A few hours per chair, since we already assembled and tested it in our warehouse. A free ocular visit comes first.

exchanges.question: Can the purchase be financed?
exchanges.answer: Yes. Installment through us or your own bank. Either way, we prepare the quote and the documents.
